reports.desc: I ordered from an ad on my phone.  After I placed the order I found out from the real company that the link they used was  a scam link.  I attempted to email them and told them i wanted  a return label because I was returning the product. They never responded.  There is no phone number to contact them.  After the order was placed the ad never came back.  I received the product today.  I do not know how to return it and get a refund.

I ordered a pair of sandals from Northend Shop in what I thought was located in Denver, Colorado. I received a cheap pair of plastic Sandals from China. They are wanting me to pay to have them shipped back at my expense. Which is half the price of what I paid for the shoes. I even sent them pictures and they refuse to resolve this any other way! Never order from this company. When you call them they tell you to leave a message and never return your call!  When looking at reviews they look good until you research the company! DO NOT ORDER FROM NORTHEND SHOP!

I ask for a loan for $2000.00, they okay we can help you. First we send you 1477.00 and send it back using chim or cash app. I send the money back through cash app. Now my bank said I am negative-1477.00 because the check they submitted was a fake,  now that leaves me pay back the bank.
Bill sent by pay pal for 406.24 requesting pay from my account

Saw an ad on FB that said he was a retired baker from NY selling his beeswax bread bags BOGO…received the bags from an address in CA…bags did not say Brenner Bakery on them as pictured and were made of plastic…contacted them
and said I would report them if I didn’t receive a full refund…they offered a partial refund…contacted credit card company, received a full refund…

This is a Real estate Scheme that was use own me  I Invested $25,000 on Rehab real estate Investment Project called a Joint Investment project. with Anderson Booth Campbell and he never returned
my money or phone calls.
Upon starting an LLC I received a letter stating I needed to pay for a “certificate of status” to be in compliance and open a business bank account.<br class="t-last-br" />

I ordered a hoodie from the brand PelfWorld on July 8th 2026. On the website the shipping says it should take 3-5 business days. It’s currently August 14, 2026 and the brand owner has blocked me and even friends of mine after contacting him regarding my money.

I have received several calls asking for my daughter in law. Saying they were trying to reach her about a new meter that was installed recently at her/sons address. There's not been a new meter installed. Son and daughter in law know nothing about this. I told the man that there was no one here by her name and to stop calling. Hes called twice since this. Last time he used sam÷ number and hung up on me when i told him to give me his name or company name and their phone number. He called again today from 447-200-4727 Melvin IL he hung up on me when i requested to speak to his manager.

I applied for a job that was advertised on LinkedIn. I’ve continued to get emails with requests for additional information, and I’ve suddenly started to get spam to my email address (which I’ve rarely used outside of professional activities). I also tried to unsubscribe and I keep getting emails from this scammer trying to get me to pay to “promote” my resume.

Took the money to help me move but never showed up and stopped answering calls after they got payment and all my information. When I looked up reviews I saw they they had never came for other customers time and time again.

I NEVER ORDERED or purchased the dresses I was scammed on. I never RECEIVED any dresses.
How do I get my money back/

Was scrolling one night on instagram saw an add for a mega tablet for 39.99 decided to buy and it all went down hill from there to the shipment delays to the we tried to deliver but no one was available to receive the item although the house was full of people. I ordered on 7/18and have yet to receive anything but a bunch of emails

I didn’t sign up for a subscription. Allure Haven charged my husbands card 159 dollars and some cents. It’s fraudulent company that guarantees you pain relief. They didn’t mention thc in the form of a Rice Krispie bar. Watch out for this company. They have used different names of the company and different addresses located in California. The post office was cracking down on Kiwi company but needs to flag down Allure Haven. These are bad men or women. I hope someone can take them down. I called the number and the number wasn’t available. You couldn’t leave a voicemail or talk to a human. These people need to be stopped because they take your money and you receive fraudulent items that you never ordered. They charge you a subscription and it’s hard to cancel because they lie and say it’s canceled when you call them. Thank you for all you do in this matter. ***** ****
